sources.clean:
Flora-On botanical account for Vulpia bromoides. Geographic scope: Portugal; habitat descriptions and native status on this site refer to Portugal, not the global native range.

Ecologia Prados e pastagens secas, bermas de caminhos.

Distância ao mar (n=80)
